lines: Tu meri zindagi hai, tu meri har khushi hai
couplets.en: You are my life and every joy in it.

lines: Tu hi pyaar, tu hi chaahat, tu hi bandagi hai
couplets.en: All my love, my longing, my devotion are yours.

lines: Jab tak na dekhun tujhe, sooraj na nikle
couplets.en: The sun does not rise until I see you.

lines: Zulfon ke saaye saaye, mahtaab ubhre
couplets.en: The moon rises in the shadows of your hair.

lines: Mere dil ka hosh tu hai, tu hi bekhudi hai
couplets.en: My heart comes to its senses in you and loses itself in you.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai, tu meri har khushi hai
couplets.en: You are my life and every joy in it.

lines: Tu hi pyaar, tu hi chaahat, tu hi bandagi hai
couplets.en: All my love, my longing, my devotion are yours.

lines: Mere labon pe tere naghme milenge
couplets.en: On my lips you will find your songs.

lines: Aankhon mein, saathi, tere jalwe milenge
couplets.en: Look into my eyes, my love, and you will see yourself there.

lines: Mere dil mein tu hi tu hai, teri roshni hai
couplets.en: My heart holds only you and your light.

lines: Chhor ke duniya, tujh ko apna bana loon
couplets.en: I would leave the world behind to make you mine.

lines: Sab se chhupa ke, tujh ko dil mein basa loon
couplets.en: I would keep you in my heart, where no one else could see.

lines: Tu hi meri pehli khwaahish, tu hi aakhiri hai
couplets.en: You are my first wish and my last.
